body:
## Description
Validate component values for sanity and warn about unusual or problematic values.

## Problem
Users may enter invalid values (negative resistance), extreme values (1TΩ resistor), or values that could cause numerical issues.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Check for negative resistance values
- [ ] Warn about extreme values (very large/small)
- [ ] Detect zero-value components that might cause issues
- [ ] Check for realistic ranges based on component type
- [ ] Provide suggestions for typical values

## Validation Rules
- Resistance: 1mΩ to 1GΩ typical
- Capacitance: 1pF to 10,000µF typical  
- Inductance: 1nH to 10H typical
- Zero or negative values for R, L, C are errors

## Priority
Medium - Helps catch input errors and numerical issues
title: Feature: Component Value Validation
